data-gov-my-weather-warning.heading_en: Warning on Strong Wind and Rough Seas
data-gov-my-weather-warning.text_en: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Penang • Perak • Selangor • N. Sembilan • Melaka • Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan • Northern Sarawak • Western Sabah until 2:00 AM; Friday, 30 October 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Straits Of Melaka • Phuket • Samui • Tioman • Bunguran • Condore • Western part of Reef North • Sulu until 2:00 AM; Friday, 30 October 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.
data-gov-my-weather-warning.instruction_en: This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous.
